properties.entry: Shows all your trade routes on the darkened map. Viewing routes gives no orders and changes nothing in the game.
Creates a new route: choose its starting colony, its stops in order and land or sea transport. The game finds the paths between the stops.
Click a route on the map or choose it in the list. The game picks the fastest legal path between stops by movement cost, not by the number of tiles.
You have no trade routes yet. Use New trade route in the bar above to create one.
Choose a route to see its stops, goods, carriers and paths.
Paths are shown for %s. Other carriers of the route use their own movement costs.
No carrier yet: the grey lines show where a wagon (solid) or a ship (dashed) could travel. The route kind does not change: %s.
%s → %s: not shown, a stop is no longer your colony.
%s → %s: not shown, a ship needs a coastal port.
%s → %s: not shown, a wagon cannot travel to Home port.
Opens the route window with this route chosen: replace stops, set goods to unload and load, and assign or cancel carriers.
